replacements.anchor: ### AE6 — Manifold hypothesis and geometric structure
replacements.old: - [ ] Replace loose `data lie on a manifold` language with a hierarchy: low intrinsic dimension, union/stratification of manifolds, sparse/compositional latent structure, symmetry/orbit structure, graph/topological structure, and non-geometric algorithmic structure.
replacements.new: - [x] Replace loose `data lie on a manifold` language with a hierarchy: low intrinsic dimension, union/stratification of manifolds, sparse/compositional latent structure, symmetry/orbit structure, graph/topological structure, and non-geometric algorithmic structure. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae6-geometric-structure-v1` AE6-1/AE6-2: the six structure classes are evaluated as exact predicates on the Boolean cube `{0,1}^4` and separated by a strictness table over all `30` ordered pairs, `23` carrying a registered witness and `7` reported as not separated with their reasons; the exhaustive census over all `65519` supports of affine dimension at least `1` shows the frozen union-of-cosets predicate holds for `65503` of them and fails only for the `16` supports of size `15`, each with a coordinate-permutation stabilizer of order `4`, `6` or `24`, so no support can be both algorithmic and outside the union class.

replacements.anchor: ### AE6 — Manifold hypothesis and geometric structure
replacements.old: - [ ] Construct learnable distributions that violate a smooth-manifold assumption.
replacements.new: - [x] Construct learnable distributions that violate a smooth-manifold assumption. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae6-geometric-structure-v1` AE6-3: `S_NONMANIFOLD_LEARNABLE` is a dimension-`2` coset and a dimension-`1` coset meeting in one point, with non-constant Hamming-1 degree sequence `[1, 2, 2, 2, 3]` and maximal-coset dimensions `{1, 2}`, and a member of the registered rule class `M_local[2]` attains exact accuracy `1` on it at integer cost `13` bits.

replacements.anchor: ### AE6 — Manifold hypothesis and geometric structure
replacements.old: - [ ] Construct low-dimensional manifolds that are statistically/causally useless for the target task.
replacements.new: - [x] Construct low-dimensional manifolds that are statistically/causally useless for the target task. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae6-geometric-structure-v1` AE6-4: a GF(2) factor of dimension `1` has exact mutual information `0` bits with the target and exact interventional effect `0` while the best rule reading it alone scores exactly the base rate `1/2` and a single coordinate of the complementary full-dimension factor scores `1` with interventional effect `1`; the stronger conjunction that put the whole support at dimension `1` is proved unsatisfiable, `0` of `480` dimension-1 cases and `0` violations over `34112` cases, and prediction `AE6-P3` is reported `REFUTED` rather than edited.

replacements.anchor: ### AE6 — Manifold hypothesis and geometric structure
replacements.old: - [ ] Derive when locality/smoothness should favor local/shared operators.
replacements.new: - [x] Derive when locality/smoothness should favor local/shared operators. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae6-geometric-structure-v1` AE6-5: if some 2-subset of coordinates determines the target exactly then `M_local[2]` attains accuracy `1` at integer cost `13` bits while the monolithic comparator at the same budget attains at most `7/8`, and on the matched failure world where no 2-subset determines the target `M_local[2]` attains `15/16` against the comparator's `1`, an exact drop of `1/16`.

not_closed.anchor: ### AE6 — Manifold hypothesis and geometric structure
not_closed.row: - [ ] Prospectively test intrinsic-structure -> morphology transitions on synthetic and real datasets.
not_closed.reason: this row is prospective and names real datasets; this package is an exact finite construction on a 16-point Boolean cube and no finite exact roster can stand in for a real corpus
not_closed.instrument_required: a pre-registered dataset instrument that (a) names the real corpora and their versioned checksums before any structure estimate is computed, (b) supplies an intrinsic-dimension estimator and an orbit-structure estimator each with a stated confidence procedure on finite samples and a stated failure mode, (c) fixes the held-out split, the model-class budget ladder and the decision rule in advance, and (d) records the prediction and the outcome under the same custody discipline as PROSPECTIVE_REGISTER_V1.json. None of (a)-(d) exists in this repository.
